artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for the Typst chapter-quality standard: all five plan phases completed in one pass, acceptance criteria verified.

completion_data.completion_summary: Created agent-system/extensions/typst/context/project/typst/standards/chapter-quality.md defining the four settled dimensions (SOURCE GROUNDING, ANTI-FLUFF DENSITY, PRESENTATION CLARITY, OPEN-QUESTION HONESTY) with 15 dual-tagged rules (BLOCKING-or-ADVISORY x MECHANICAL-or-JUDGED), cross-references to three existing standards, an interface contract for two repo-local checks, and a rationale section.

memory_candidates.content: In the typst extension's context/project/typst/standards/ directory, sibling standards cross-reference each other using a 'standards/<file>.md' prefix (relative to context/project/typst/), not bare filenames -- e.g. semantic-element-usage.md writes `standards/textbook-standards.md`, and scripts/typst-element-lint.sh's own header does the same. Patterns files use a parallel 'patterns/<file>.md' prefix. When authoring a new standard in this directory, match this prefix convention for any backticked cross-reference so path-resolution rules (e.g. 'every backticked path resolves against the live tree') hold true against the established convention rather than against a bare filename that only resolves by accident of directory context.
